QUOTE: `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h` has both `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` (line 3787) and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (line 2196) commented out.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names both macros as the ones gating the threading code, stating they are commented out by default and that `library/threading.c` is guarded by `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` and uses `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` for the pthread backend.
